scope: verified recorded sources; not account billing completeness

Summary.unmeasuredTurns: u64(default0): genuine owned turns with no requests

Conversation.usageRevision: opaque stable hash of own cursor state/offsets + parserVersion + lineage + own warning/availability + verified namespace

existingRequestKey: immutable, retain existing value when attaching source/correction

selection.details: selected node plus accepted descendant subtree
selection.agents: flat selected-first preorder, children ordered by agentPath then id
selection.uiRows: roots, legacy unknown single nodes and unresolved/orphan/invalid detached nodes
selection.terminalIdentity: retain all IDs; map a resolved child OSC ID to its resolved root; never bind by arbitrary child title

coverage.complete: all available accepted recorded sources have verified ownership/relations and measured own turns
coverage.partial: some reliable data exists with a material attribution/source/measurement gap
coverage.unknown: no supported attribution proof or no measured amount for the known owned work
coverage.emptyHistory: complete zero when source is healthy and no owned turns exist
coverage.legacySingle: unknown source coverage without an invented child warning

migration.lock: existing ledger file lock, held across read/backup/migrate/write
migration.backup: immutable byte-exact v1 snapshot, atomically created with create-once semantics before replacement
migration.backupExisting: reuse only if same bytes; otherwise preserve both inputs and fail without replacing either
migration.schemaUpgrade: retain all keys,tokens,prices,corrections,states; add defaults only
migration.replay: retain old entries; uniquely attach source/correction; never append a matched second request
migration.pricingCorrection: use saved rates only; if corrected historical pricing class cannot be proven, preserve snapshot and leave cost unpriced

copiedOwnership.inheritedHeader: foreign session_meta matching declared fork origin is context only
copiedOwnership.missingOrConflict: unknown ownership; preserve trustworthy exact usage and suppress unproven owned lifecycle

liveDetail.publish: Dashboard comparison includes revision and metadata
